gaps: Certified list (cert-list-candidates.pdf) prints only name, party preference, ballot designation (and * for incumbent on state/legislative offices). It prints NO website or email. Websites/emails were taken from the companion official SoS 'Official Candidate Contact List' (contact-list.pdf, dated 9/23/26, 50 pages). All 324 candidates in the two documents match exactly on name, party and designation. Websites printed for 218 of 324 candidates; emails for 227. null = nothing printed. Websites are stored exactly as printed (217 have no http(s):// scheme; 1 has https://).

Contact list is dated 9/23/26 (later than the 8/27/26 certification). It was matched against the certified list and no candidate-level differences were found, but contact details can change after 9/23/26; re-check before publishing.

Incumbent flag: the certified list marks incumbents with * only for statewide-office, State Senate and State Assembly contests. It does NOT mark incumbents for U.S. House, so incumbent is null for every U.S. House candidate. For all other contests, incumbent=false means no * was printed.

Ballot designation is stored exactly as printed; where the list prints 'No Ballot Designation' that literal text is kept (not converted to null). Sally J. Lieber (BOE 2) and LaShae Sharp-Collins (AD 79) have the single word 'Incumbent' printed as their designation.
San Joaquin County has NO even-numbered State Senate district on the 2026 ballot (its senate district is SD 5, odd-numbered, last elected 2024). Alameda County: only SD 10 is on the 2026 ballot.

Requested-but-not-covering districts are still included in contests[] (flagged by covers_counties=[]): U.S. House 11, 15, 16, 18, 19; State Senate 4, 6, 8, 12; State Assembly 22, 26; BOE 3 and 4. They do not touch San Joaquin or Alameda per the SoS June 2026 Statement of Vote.

District coverage is county-level overlap from certified vote returns, not voter-level. Several districts only touch a sliver of a county (e.g. CD5 and CD8 in San Joaquin; CD10 and CD17 in Alameda; AD9 spans San Joaquin plus Sacramento/Stanislaus/Amador/Calaveras). A given voter's districts need an address lookup (Alameda: https://alamedacountyca.gov/rovapps/districtlookup/ ; San Joaquin ROV 'Find Your Elected Officials and Districts' page currently says 'Coming soon').

Prop 50 boundary files/maps were not downloaded or independently checked. Coverage was derived from certified counts of the June 2, 2026 primary (which used the post-Prop 50 congressional map) and cross-checked against both county Registrars' own 2026 documents; all three agree.

Alameda ROV also lists 'Congressional District 14 Special Primary Election 06/16/2026' and 'Congressional District 14 Special General Election 08/18/2026' (separate vacancy-filling elections). They are not part of the Nov 3 certified list and were not researched.

Retention section layout anomaly in the certified PDF: First District Division Three, Four and Five justices (Petrou, Rodriguez, Brown, Simons, Chou, Burns) are printed on page 34 under the heading 'Court of Appeal - Second Appellate District' (heading placement only; each item's own label says First District). Similarly Fourth District Div 2/3 justices print under the Fifth District heading (outside requested scope). Division membership here follows each item's own label, not the section heading. Treat as a possible SoS layout error; verify the 1st District roster before publishing.

Retention question for DAVID B. SAPP (Third District) is printed without the 'Associate Justice' title in the question text ('Shall DAVID B. SAPP be elected...'); the office label above it says Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Third District. Kept as printed.

Single-candidate Assembly contests printed on the certified list: AD 4, AD 8, AD 22, AD 32 (AD 22 is in the requested set). Several contests have two candidates of the same party, as printed (e.g. CD7, CD11, CD12, CD14, Insurance Commissioner, AD12, AD18).
Candidate mailing addresses and phone numbers are printed in the contact list but were deliberately NOT captured (not requested; may be residences).

The task-supplied SoS page URL .../general-election-nov-3-2026 returns 404; the working page is https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/upcoming-elections/general-election-november-3-2026 (it links the same cert-list PDF, last-modified Fri 28 Aug 2026 00:38:33 GMT).
Alameda ROV online Candidate List (rov_app/candidatelist) did not return candidate rows to a plain scripted POST; it was used only for its race list. Not used for candidate data.
